Based on the release schedule and detailed notes, the three features have distinct planned availability timelines, target audiences, and known risks:

- **Advanced OCR Pipeline**: Scheduled for general release in **August 2026** (v2.8.0, target date August 25, 2026) as a standard component of the KnowledgeHub ingestion layer [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S06]. Its plan availability is tiered: included natively in the Enterprise plan, offered as a paid add-on for Growth plans ($500/month), and not supported on the Starter plan due to hardware requirements [NL-014#NL-014-S06].
- **WorkflowCoach Public Beta**: Officially targeted for **September 2026** (v2.9.0, target date September 29, 2026) and available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-002#NL-002-S07]. However, internal engineering and leadership notes indicate the September target is in serious jeopardy due to state management and permission inheritance issues, with a realistic slip to **November 2026** [NL-015#NL-015-S05][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. A private beta may be released in September only for customers with flat document structures and no sensitive compliance data [NL-015#NL-015-S05].
- **Teams connector**: Planned strictly as a future release for **Q4 2026** (v2.11.0, November release) [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. A restricted pilot begins in **October 2026** with selected financial and healthcare accounts to validate security isolation before general release [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. Sales materials should not pre-sell it as ready [NL-015#NL-015-S09].

In summary, Advanced OCR (Aug 2026) has the earliest planned release with tiered plan availability; WorkflowCoach public beta officially targets Sept 2026 but risks slipping to Nov 2026; and the Teams connector is the farthest out, planned for Nov 2026 with an Oct 2026 pilot.
